title: Spiced Chicken, Cheddar and Jack Quesadillas with Pickled Jalapeños
summary: Spiced chicken breasts are pan-cooked to 74 °C and shredded, mixed with two cheeses, jalapeños and spring onions, then folded into tortillas and cooked until crisp.
equipment: large non-stick frying pan (at least 26 cm)
wire rack set on a baking tray

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Rub the breasts with the oil, chilli powder and cumin. Cook in the pan over medium heat for 5-6 minutes per side until 74 °C in the thickest part. Rest 5 minutes, shred with two forks and wipe out the pan.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.text: Toss the chicken with both cheeses, the jalapeños and spring onions in the bowl.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Scatter a quarter of the filling over one half of each tortilla, leaving a 1 cm border, and fold over, pressing gently.

steps.title: Heat up
steps.text: Put the rack on its tray in a 100 °C (80 °C fan) oven. Heat 1 tbsp oil in the pan over medium heat.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook 2 quesadillas for 2-3 minutes until crisp and golden underneath, then flip and cook 2 minutes more until the cheese has melted and the filling is piping hot. Keep warm on the rack and repeat with the remaining oil.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cut each into 3 wedges and serve with soured cream and lime wedges.

tips: No salt is added: the cheese, jalapeños and tortillas season the filling.
Mixing the filling first means every wedge gets chicken and cheese.
Leftover roast chicken works too; use about 300 g shredded.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour and eat within 3 days. Reheat in a dry pan until piping hot (74 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
